verses.text: Ha in Pablo in tik, schekab' in Jesucristo. Manhok junok anima ay in schekab'. Hanhejtona', manhok junok anima ak'jinak wopisio tik. Ha wal Jesucristo chi' ak'jinak t'ayin yet' ko Mam Dios, haton jun ak'jinakxi pitzwok Jesucristo t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ha in tik yet' masanil heb' kuk'tak ayek' wet'ok, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko carta tik t'ayex ex creyente t'a junjun iglesia t'a yol yik Galacia.
Aokab' ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo syak' swach'k'olal yet' sjunk'olal t'ayex ta'.
Ha Jesucristo, yak'nak cham sb'a yik tzul yik'kanel ko mul. Icha chi' ix yutej onh skolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chukal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto icha chi' snib'ej Dios, haton ko Mam yaji.
Yuj chi', kalek wach' lolonel t'a Dios t'a masanil tiempo. Amén.
Tzin och k'elan eyuuj, yujto elanhchamel wan eyaktankan Dios, haton ix onh awtan yuj swach'k'olal Cristo. Yujto a tiknaik, wan eyak'anoch he pensar t'a junxo ab'ix yik kolnab'il ch'ok tz'alji t'ayex.
Palta malaj junokxo ab'ix yik kolnab'il chi'. Ay heb' snib'ej sk'exan swayanhil yab'ixal Cristo yik swach' somchajel he pensar.

Palta ek'nak onhxo kalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il chi' t'ayex. Haxo tiknaik, tato ay junok mach tzek' yalel junokxo ch'ok k'ayb'ub'al, wach'chom a in tik, ma junok ángel skot t'a satcha'anh tzul alanok, kotokab' yowal sk'ool Dios t'a yib'anh.

Icha wutejnak walankan t'ayex junel, icha chi' swutej walanxib'at t'ayex tiknaik. Tato ay junok mach tzek' alanel junokxo k'ayb'ub'al manh lajanok yet' jun he chanakxo, kotokab' yowal sk'ool Dios t'a yib'anh.

Ayik swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, ¿tom in gana ste tzalaj junok anima wet' he naani? Maay, anhej Dios in gana stzalaj wet'ok. Manh jab'ok tzin na' to stzalaj heb' wet'ok. K'inalok a heb' anima in gana stzalaj wet'ok, manh in schekab'ok am Cristo syal chi'.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzin nib'ej tzeyojtakejel junxo swal tik. Ha jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il swal tik, manh yikok anima.
Manhok t'a junok anima in chanak, ma in k'ayb'ejnak, yujto anhej wal Jesucristo ak'jinak wojtakejeli.

Eyab'nakxo chajtil wutejnak in b'a t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik wak'annak och in b'a t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' wetisraelal. Niwan wal yaelal wak'nak och t'a yib'anh heb' yikxo Dios. Wak'nak wal wip in satanel heb'.
Ha t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' wetchonhab' chi', a innhej te jelan in t'a yichanh heb' lajan in k 'inal yet'ok, yujto wak'nak wal och in pensar t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' ko mam kicham.
Palta ayik manto in alji, ha Dios sik'jinak inxo eli. Yuj swach'k'olal yawtejnak in och yikok. Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal icha tas nab'il yuj,
ix yak'an wojtakejel Yuninal, yik wach' tzek' walel yab'ixal kolnab'il t'a he kal a ex manh ex israelok tik. Slajwi chi', malaj junok mach b'aj in k'anb'ej tas wach' tzin k'ulej.
Manh in xit'nakokpaxek' t'a Jerusalén in k'umej heb' b'ab'laj ochnak schekab'ok Cristo t'a wichanh. Palta elanhchamel b'at in kan t'a yol yik Arabia. Slajwi chi', in k'ochxi t'a chonhab' Damasco.
Hato t'a yoxil ab'il b'at in t'a Jerusalén, yik b'at wil winhaj Pedro, 15 k'ual ek' in yet' winh.
Manhxa junokxo heb' schekab' Cristo in k'umej ta', anhej winhaj Jacobo, winh yuk'tak sb'a yet' Kajal Jesús in k'umej.
T'a yichanh Dios swalb'at jun tik t'ayex, te yel tas swal tik.
Slajwi wek' t'a Jerusalén chi', in b'at t'a yol yik Siria yet' t'a yol yik Cilicia.
Haxo heb' yikxo Cristo ay t'a yol yik Judea, manto in yojtakoklaj heb'.

Tonhejanto tz'alji yab' heb': Ha jun winh ak'jinak och ko yaelal t'a yalanhtaxo, haton winh snib'ejnak satanel jun k'ayb'ub'al chab'ilxo kuuj, a tiknaik, a winh tzek' alanxiel yab'ixal, xchi heb' wuuj.
Yuj chi', yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios smasanil wuuj.
